title: Importing virtuus fails on Windows: UnixService subclasses a Unix-only socketserver class
description: python/src/virtuus/service.py defines UnixService(socketserver.ThreadingUnixStreamServer) at import time, and virtuus/__init__.py imports it, so 'import virtuus' raises AttributeError on Windows. Kanbus pins this revision and its Windows install CI job fails. Fix: define the Unix-socket host only where the platform provides it, keep UnixService importable everywhere with a clear error when started without Unix sockets, and add a Windows import check to CI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in AnthusAI/Virtuus#30 (merged into develop), released in v0.6.0 via #29. UnixService is only a ThreadingUnixStreamServer subclass where the platform provides it; elsewhere it raises OSError when started. CI now runs an import check on windows-latest and macos-14.
